title: Minimum Limit of Balls in a Bag
goal: Minimize the greatest bag size after a limited number of bag splits.
strategy: For a candidate maximum, each original bag needs ceil(size/maximum)-1 splits. Required operations decrease as the candidate grows, enabling binary search.
